'''Manuke''' (Japanese: '''マヌーク''' ''Manuke'') is a minor supporting character who appeared in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. He lives in the arid desert, where he works for his village's leader [[Ravine]].

==In the movies==
In ''White—Victini and Zekrom'', Manuke witnessed, along with the rest of the village, [[Damon]] summoning {{OBP|Reshiram|M14}} in order to save them from a tornado and a rampaging herd of {{p|Bouffalant}}. In ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'', he was seen in Damon's flashback of him asking Ravine to support his idea. After Ravine tossed Damon's book on the ground, refusing his idea, Manuke picked it up and handed it to him.

Manuke was later seen with Ravine and [[Luisa]], along with the people of the tundra village, in both movies, where they show their support for Damon's idea.
